name: adminhead
description: Adminhead's Claude Code plugins: skills, agents, commands, hooks, and MCP servers.

plugins.name: baseline
plugins.description: The default adminhead set: installs the everyday plugins (coding, review, research, testing, GitHub, git, code search, authoring, setup, coremods, and crew) in one step. Ships no skills of its own.

plugins.name: code-search
plugins.description: Code search: ripgrep, CodeGraph's local symbol graph with auto-indexing, Context7 library docs, public GitHub code via grep.app, and always-on search guidelines.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git skills: focused commits, branches, history rewrites and recovery, and worktrees.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: GitHub workflow skills: issues, issue breakdown, triage, pull requests and review comments, shipping commits through merge, and releases, plus the GitHub remote MCP server.

plugins.name: github-admin
plugins.description: GitHub repository administration: Actions workflows, code security settings and alerts, Dependabot config and PR sweeps, and repo setup.

plugins.name: coding-core
plugins.description: Coding process skills: the coding workflow, planning, problem-solving, and implementing an approved plan.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Review skills: second-opinion reviews from another model, review-fix loops, anti-slop cleanup, and poka-yoke error-proofing.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Research skill for cited answers to external questions, plus the Exa web search MCP server.

plugins.name: prototype
plugins.description: Throwaway prototypes that answer one design question, as a single-file logic demo or as UI variants.

plugins.name: experiment-loop
plugins.description: Autonomous optimize-and-measure loops on a dedicated git branch, with one hypothesis per commit and a results log.

plugins.name: modernize
plugins.description: Plans for modernizing a legacy system: feasibility spike, safety ladder, hazard red-team, and phased exit criteria.

plugins.name: coding-shell
plugins.description: Shell skills: Bash scripting practice.

plugins.name: coding-go
plugins.description: Go skills: the language, CLI tools, and performance work.

plugins.name: coding-python
plugins.description: Python skills: the language, packaging, and FastAPI services.

plugins.name: coding-js
plugins.description: JavaScript and TypeScript skills: the languages, React, Vue, Vite, TanStack, and click-path audits of UI flows.

plugins.name: coding-rust
plugins.description: Rust skills: the language and its tooling.

plugins.name: web
plugins.description: Web skills: front-end web development and web design, plus a headless Playwright MCP browser.

plugins.name: auth
plugins.description: Authentication skills: login, sessions, and token validation for your own app, plus Better Auth.

plugins.name: db
plugins.description: Database skills: schema design, Postgres, MySQL, and Redis.

plugins.name: coding-esp
plugins.description: ESP32 skills: ESP-IDF firmware engineering.

plugins.name: testing
plugins.description: Testing skills: unit and regression tests, browser end-to-end tests, running the project's tests, building test harnesses, and auditing test gaps.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Security skills: threat modeling, privacy review, and a manual security audit scan.

plugins.name: authoring
plugins.description: Skills for authoring Claude Code skills, agent instruction files, architecture decision records, and docs; mapping codebases and domain models; planning agent teams; and auditing documentation and reviewing Claude Code config for bloat and security.

plugins.name: devenv
plugins.description: Configure, migrate, debug, and verify devenv.sh developer environments.

plugins.name: chezmoi
plugins.description: Manage, migrate, and troubleshoot chezmoi-managed dotfiles.

plugins.name: pass-cli
plugins.description: Use the Proton Pass CLI without exposing secrets.

plugins.name: sentry-core
plugins.description: Instrument apps with official Sentry SDKs.

plugins.name: sentry-mcp
plugins.description: Sentry's remote MCP server (OAuth) for querying issues, events, traces, and releases on sentry.io. Off until enabled.

plugins.name: sentry-mcp-self-hosted
plugins.description: Sentry's MCP server over stdio with a user auth token, for self-hosted Sentry. Off until enabled; prompts for host and token.

plugins.name: playwright-cli
plugins.description: Drive a headless, isolated browser from Bash with playwright-cli.

plugins.name: termwright
plugins.description: Drive and test terminal UI apps with the termwright CLI.

plugins.name: accessibility
plugins.description: Accessibility skills: manual screen-reader and keyboard testing of web journeys.

plugins.name: tooling
plugins.description: Repo tooling skills: EditorConfig files and commit-time hooks with prek or pre-commit, and repairing failing hooks.

plugins.name: observability
plugins.description: Observability skills: instrumentation and SLOs, PromQL and Prometheus config, Grafana dashboards, and blameless postmortems.

plugins.name: api
plugins.description: Public API design skills: REST contracts, idempotency and retries, webhooks, versioning, gRPC, GraphQL, API keys, and OAuth providers.

plugins.name: infra
plugins.description: Infrastructure skills: Terraform (with OpenTofu and Terragrunt) and Ansible, plus a guard hook for unsafe `tofu` and `aws` commands.

plugins.name: deploy
plugins.description: Deployment skills: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, GitOps, rollouts, and production-readiness reviews.

plugins.name: homelab
plugins.description: Home and homelab network planning: VLANs, trust zones, DNS cutover, and WireGuard tunnels, read-only first.

plugins.name: mcp
plugins.description: Model Context Protocol server skills: design the tool surface, build with the official SDKs, and review security and release readiness.

plugins.name: aws
plugins.description: AWS skills: resource inspection, CloudWatch incident investigation, and Well-Architected and cost review, plus the AWS MCP Server.

plugins.name: coremods
plugins.description: A home for the user's core Claude Code mods: a git status line under the prompt, a usage band above it, and an agent status line with an expandable panel, plus read-only git log, blame and show tools for subagents and tool-mgr, which blocks Bash sed file reads, heredoc, printf and echo file writes, and dangerous commands (rm -rf of system paths, disk wipes, sudo), asks before piped installers and git force-pushes, optionally adds asks and denies through a local model check, and keeps a per-call log with DuckDB metrics. Requires Claude Code 2.1.289 or later.

plugins.name: setup
plugins.description: Setup skills: recommend and install the adminhead plugins that fit the current project.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: The orchestrated-session crew: 14 subagents (coders, reviewers, debuggers, architect, devops, dba, scribe, browser tester) plus the orchestration main-thread agent, with a read-only Bash gate for the read-only agents, orchestration nudge hooks, and the orchestration system-prompt file. Agents are spawned as crew:<name>.
